summary: Analysts say the client's small amount of money cannot be used to buy Indian public offerings or single Indian shares because the minimum required investment is much higher and fees would eat most of it. They note that buying a small piece of Nvidia through a US broker with no commissions is the only practical way to invest the practice money right now. They advise keeping the practice money in cash for now and waiting for a better moment to buy a small piece of Nvidia when the price drops to a certain level.
